articles.headline: Tottenham's rare win at Chelsea signals progress under De Zerbi
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur secured only their second Premier League win at Stamford Bridge as Chelsea's goalkeeping woes and disciplinary issues resurfaced.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナムがチェルシー戦で稀に見る勝利、デ・ゼルビ体制下の進歩を印象付ける
articles.descriptionJa: チェルシーのゴールキーパー問題と規律上の課題が再燃する中、トッテナム・ホットスパーはスタンフォード・ブリッジでのプレミアリーグ通算2勝目となる貴重な勝利を収めた。
articles.body:
LONDON --  Tottenham Hotspur ended their Stamford Bridge hoodoo on Saturday as Mike Penders' calamitous own goal and Mathys Tel's brilliant late strike gave Spurs a 2-0 win over 10-man Chelsea.

Roberto De Zerbi's side had won just one of their previous 33 Premier League visits here, but they deserved this hard-fought victory in rain-swept, windy conditions on Saturday.

Spurs edged an even first half before the game sparked into life in the 69th minute. Mateus Fernandes handled the ball as he attempted to stop Cole Palmer breaking forward. Both players were booked after Palmer leaned into Fernandes, sparking a confrontation between staff from each club on the touchline.

Spurs continued to look more authoritative in possession as Chelsea -- without João Pedro due to an unspecified injury sustained in training Friday -- lacked the attacking fluidity they have shown under Xabi Alonso.

And they took the lead in the 77th minute when Fernandes curled a corner into the box and Penders, on his first league start, punched the ball into his own net.

Palmer was then shown a second yellow card for a late tackle on former Blues midfielder Conor Gallagher before Tel drove forward and unleashed a fine 20-yard shot into the bottom corner. Alonso suffered his first home defeat as Chelsea boss as the Blues remain in fourth place while Spurs climbed up to 12th in the table. -- James Olley

Spurs and De Zerbi secure landmark win

De Zerbi's reaction to Tel's wonderful late strike said everything. It was not unlike Jose Mourinho -- who managed both of these clubs -- famously running down the touchline as the Italian stooped low and made a dart towards the ecstatic away end, which has endured so much pain on this ground over the years.

Spurs' sole Premier League victory here came in April 2018, and few gave them a realistic chance of improving that record after a difficult start to the season. But after spending around £400 million in the summer to revamp their squad, this was the statement win Tottenham have been looking for to kickstart their new era. And they deserved it.

They showed bravery in possession, and although the breakthrough came courtesy of a bad mistake from Penders, it was just reward for the greater threat they showed throughout.

Fernandes has had a mixed start to life at the club, but he was at the heart of everything here: his decision to stop Chelsea's attack sparked the flashpoint that brought the game into life, and it was his corner that Penders turned into his own net.

He had more touches (121) than anyone else, completed 91 of his 99 passes, and made the most tackles (five). That combination of grit and quality is what Spurs have so badly lacked, but this is a result that will give Spurs firm belief that they are finally moving in the right direction. -- Olley

Chelsea's goalkeeper woes continue

articles.headline: Chelsea's Xabi Alonso after Tottenham defeat: 'We lose together,' not fault of Mike Penders
articles.description: Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso refused to blame stand-in goalkeeper Mike Penders for his key error which helped Tottenham to a 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, and said Cole Palmer will learn from his red card.
articles.headlineJa: トッテナムに敗れたチェルシーのアロンソ監督：「負けはチーム全体の責任」、パンダースのせいではない
articles.descriptionJa: チェルシーのアロンソ監督は、土曜日のスタンフォード・ブリッジでのトッテナム戦（0-2で敗戦）を招いた決定的なミスについて、代役ゴールキーパーのマイク・パンダースを責めることを拒否し、コール・パルマーは退場処分から学ぶだろうと述べた。
articles.body:
LONDON -- Chelsea manager Xabi Alonso refused to blame stand-in goalkeeper Mike Penders for his key error which helped Tottenham to a 2-0 win at Stamford Bridge on Saturday, and said Cole Palmer will learn from his red card.

Tottenham headed to Chelsea knowing they'd only won one league match at Stamford Bridge in 33 seasons. But Spurs dominated much of the game, and came away with a key victory against a Chelsea side who finished with 10 men after Palmer was sent off in the 80th minute for two yellow cards.

Penders' own goal gave Spurs the lead in the 77th minute when the Chelsea keeper, deputising for the injured Emiliano Martínez, punched a corner into his own net.

It was Penders' first league start for Chelsea and from there, Spurs doubled their lead in the 87th minute through Mathys Tel, by which time Palmer had been dismissed for two yellow cards.

Palmer's first yellow was for a push on Mateus Fernandes -- an act Spurs manager Roberto de Zerbi thought warranted a red card in its own right -- and the second booking was for a late challenge on Conor Gallagher.

But despite the key error from his keeper, Alonso said the team must take collective responsibility for the defeat.

"We win and we lose together, it's part of the job to deal with and overcome mistakes. I know this myself as well. We support Mike, we support the others and he will learn from that and he will want to prove he can do better and we must show we can do better," he said.

And regarding Palmer's red card, Alonso said: "I haven't seen them but I've told that probably it was right, it was our first red card, and we need to continue in this way to have the maturity to cope in those moments. When it was 1-0, there was still 20 minutes left to go. I need to check the reaction to talk with Cole but it is one to learn from in the future."

- James Maddison's injury woes return, forced off for Tottenham vs. Chelsea

- Roberto De Zerbi: Tottenham are 'a complete team' after win at Chelsea

- As it happened: De Zerbi's men dominate at Stamford Bridge as Palmer shown red card

On whether Palmer's lack of composure was a worry, Alonso said: "It's not a concern, his focus on the game when he's enjoying it and after the 1-0 it's key to keep calm and mature."

Chelsea were without injured forward João Pedro and lacked bite in attack. "We don't know yet as there's a lot of fluid," Alonso said. "He felt it yesterday, we need to wait until tomorrow to do the tests to learn about the situation and the seriousness of the injury and we will know soon enough."

The defeat will come as a setback after Chelsea were showing progress under Alonso following a comprehensive win over Bournemouth and an impressive win at Everton. "For sure we are disappointed with the result, with the performance," Alonso said.

"At half-time we spoke and we thought it was going to be about the first goal -- the second half was about being tight, there were some half chances from them and us. It was about key moment

articles.headline: Roberto De Zerbi: Tottenham are 'a complete team' after win at Chelsea
articles.description: Roberto De Zerbi has described Tottenham as "the complete team" after Saturday's 2-0 win at 10-man Chelsea.
articles.headlineJa: ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督：チェルシー戦勝利後、トッテナムを「完成されたチーム」と評する
articles.descriptionJa: ロベルト・デ・ゼルビ監督は、土曜日に10人となったチェルシーに2-0で勝利した後、トッテナムを「完成されたチーム」と表現した。
articles.body:
LONDON -- Roberto De Zerbi has described Tottenham as "a complete team" after Saturday's 2-0 win at 10-man Chelsea.

Spurs secured only their second win at Stamford Bridge in 34 Premier League visits as Mike Penders' 77th-minute own goal and Mathys Tel's fine individual effort 10 minutes later secured a rare win.

Cole Palmer was sent off in between for two yellow cards, the first awarded for reacting to Mateus Fernandes as he handled to stop a Chelsea attack before receiving his marching orders for a late challenge on substitute Conor Gallagher.

Tottenham deserved their victory in what stands out as a landmark result of De Zerbi's tenure after a slow start to the season in which they sat bottom of the table despite spending around £400 million ($535m) on 10 new signings after narrowly avoiding relegation last term.

"It was a big moment for the fans, the club and the players also," he said. "They deserved this win, they prepared very well. We are improving a lot, we are improving in the mentality, in the group and the relationships with the players and then we are improving on the pitch.

"Against Aston Villa, Everton for 30 minutes we were playing very well. Maybe no goals, no finishing good enough to score and maybe in the first bad moment we changed mentality. Now it is a complete team. The players are playing better, we improved in the style.

"When we stay for dinner and stay together in the dressing room I see a different group, a different relationship and different atmosphere among the players."

De Zerbi revealed the squad held a meeting prior to the club's 1-1 draw at Manchester United earlier this month which he believes could be a turning point in their season.

"We are working to change the mentality of our club in the last season," he said. "Before Manchester, we spoke a lot, a big, big meeting, removing the mask and speaking honestly, clearly in front of ourselves. From that moment I think it changed something in ourselves."

- James Maddison's injury woes return, forced off for Tottenham vs. Chelsea

- Cole Palmer sent off for first time, Chelsea reach unwanted red card milestone

- Chelsea 0-2 Tottenham: De Zerbi's men dominate at Stamford Bridge as Palmer shown red card - as it happened

The only downside was an injury to James Maddison, who looked excellent but was forced off six minutes into the second half on only his second start in almost 18 months following ACL surgery.

De Zerbi said: "I think it is not a very important problem. We need to do the medical checks tomorrow, after tomorrow I don't know. I hope it is not a big problem because he is a special player for us. We need him."

articles.headline: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson (ankle) vs. Bengals; Tyler 'Snoop' Huntley to start
articles.description: The Baltimore Ravens have ruled QB Lamar Jackson out of Sundays game vs. the Cincinnati Bengals as he continues to deal with a high ankle sprain. Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will get the start.
articles.headlineJa: レイブンズ、ベンガルズ戦にラマー・ジャクソン（足首）を欠場、タイラー・“スヌープ”・ハントリーが先発へ
articles.descriptionJa: ボルチモア・レイブンズは、足首の高位捻挫が続いているため、日曜日のシンシナティ・ベンガルズ戦にQBラマー・ジャクソンを欠場させると発表した。先発はタイラー・“スヌープ”・ハントリーが務める。
articles.body:
BALTIMORE -- The Baltimore Ravens ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.

On Saturday, the Ravens downgraded Jackson, who had been listed as questionable with a left ankle injury after being limited all week in practice.

Tyler "Snoop" Huntley will start for the Ravens for the third straight week.

Since 2019, the Ravens are 0-3, including the playoffs, against the Bengals without Jackson as their starting quarterback.

articles.headline: Make way for Arsenal, the people's Premier League champions
articles.description: The sight of Man City pulling clear at the top of the Premier League table was not a good look for the biggest league in the world. But Arsenal's win against Everton showed they are ready to fight all the way this season.
articles.headlineJa: 「民衆のチャンピオン」アーセナルに道を譲れ
articles.descriptionJa: マンチェスター・シティがプレミアリーグの首位を独走する光景は、世界最大のリーグにとって好ましいものではなかった。しかし、エバートン戦でのアーセナルの勝利は、彼らが今シーズン最後まで戦い抜く準備ができていることを示した。
articles.body:
LONDON -- Winners usually become unpopular pretty quickly because everybody wants to see the best knocked off their perch, but after capitalizing on Manchester City's first defeat of the season to move level on points with the Premier League leaders, Arsenal proved they can be people's champions as well as Premier League champions.

A routine 2-0 home win against Everton thanks to goals from defenders Ezri Konsa and Gabriel Magalhães in each half enabled the Gunners to close a three-point gap on City to just goal difference, following Aston Villa's 2-1 win against Enzo Maresca's side earlier in the day.

Who knows if we are in for an epic title race or an Arsenal procession due to the uncertainty surrounding City and the outcome of their appeal against the guilty verdict in their case against the Premier League? If their appeal is thrown out, City could be relegated rather than title winners.

"We have to just focus on what we can do," Arteta said when asked about the strange situation of battling with City at the top. "We are very pleased with 90% of our result and performances other than the Brighton game [3-0 defeat last month]."

It is too early in the season to talk of runaway leaders, but City had been looking formidable prior to their slip at Villa Park following seven straight league wins and that was becoming kind of awkward for the Premier League.

With an independent commission finding the club guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of the Premier League's financial rules last month -- City, who have lodged an appeal, were found guilty of 114 of the 115 charges -- the sight of Maresca's side pulling clear at the top of the table was not a good look for the biggest league in the world.

Just imagine the scenes at the end of the season if the disciplinary process is still unresolved and the Premier League trophy is held aloft with light blue ribbons at the Etihad.

Awkward is an understatement, especially if City have to hand the trophy back days or weeks later because of, in the words of Premier League CEO Richard Masters, "systematically breaking Premier League rules for nearly a decade."

That nightmare scenario might still happen, but Arsenal's win against Everton showed they are ready to fight City all the way this season. Arteta's side are defending champions and are desperate to retain their title.

When they won the title last season -- Arsenal's first since 2003-04 -- Arteta's team were anything but universally popular champions. Their style of play, overreliance on set-pieces and readiness to waste time, plus Arteta's touchline antics, had many rival fans hoping for yet another City title. But that animosity towards Arsenal has gone because of the reaction to City being found guilty of breaking so many rules.

articles.headline: Premier League recap: Spurs stun Chelsea, City lose unbeaten record to Villa
articles.description: Tottenham Hotspur get a rare away win against Chelsea, as Arsenal and Man City are both joint-top of the Premier League, on a Saturday full of matches across Europe.
articles.headlineJa: プレミアリーグまとめ：スパーズがチェルシーに金星、シティはヴィラに無敗記録を止められる
articles.descriptionJa: ヨーロッパ各地で試合が繰り広げられた土曜日、トッテナム・ホットスパーがチェルシーに対して珍しいアウェイ勝利を収め、アーセナルとマン・シティがプレミアリーグで並んで首位に立っている。
articles.body:
We're back with another action-packed weekend of European soccer!

In the Premier League, Aston Villa kept up their recent success at home over Manchester City to win 2-1 and end City's 100% start to the season.

Defending champions Arsenal hosted Everton at the Emirates Stadium looking to go level at the top of the table and did so after a 2-0 win, while Coventry City took on Fulham at the same time, only for the visitors to end up as 1-0 winners.

Later, we wrap up the Premier League slate with a London derby, as Xabi Alonso's Chelsea took on Tottenham Hotspur at Stamford Bridge, but it was Roberto de Zerbi's team that ended up getting a rare 2-0 win.

Elsewhere, Arsenal's women beat rivals Spurs 2-1 in the WSL, Napoli hosted AS Roma in a huge Serie A showdown that saw the match end in a dramatic 3-3 draw, while Borussia Dortmund welcomed Eintracht Frankfurt to Signal Iduna Park and ended up winning 1-0.

Enjoy all the action from Saturday's matches across Europe.

articles.headline: Mavericks' Cooper Flagg out for home opener with mild left shoulder sprain
articles.description: Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced. He will not play against the Spurs.
articles.headlineJa: マベリックスのクーパー・フラッグ、左肩の軽度捻挫によりホーム開幕戦を欠場
articles.descriptionJa: マベリックスのスターフォワード、クーパー・フラッグのMRI検査により左肩の軽度捻挫が判明したとチームが発表した。彼はスパーズ戦には出場しない。
articles.body:
DALLAS -- Mavericks star forward Cooper Flagg had an MRI on Saturday morning that revealed a mild left shoulder sprain, the team announced.

Flagg has been ruled out of Saturday night's home opener against the San Antonio Spurs. He will be reevaluated next week.

The reigning Rookie of the Year, Flagg suffered the injury when he took a flagrant foul by Indiana Pacers forward Aaron Nesmith on a breakaway late in the second quarter of the Mavericks' road win Friday night. Flagg exited moments later and did not return to the game.

Flagg, 19, was off to a fast start in his second season. He scored 32 points in Wednesday's loss to the Houston Rockets, the highest-scoring performance ever by a teenager in a season opener. He had 14 points, six assists, five rebounds, three steals and a block in 17 minutes before exiting against the Pacers.

articles.headline: Bayern Munich's Vincent Kompany 'stable,' could be away for weeks after collapse
articles.description: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany will have more tests to determine why he collapsed during a training session the previous day, the club said Saturday.
articles.headlineJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンのヴィンセント・コンパニー、容体は「安定」も失神により数週間の離脱の可能性
articles.descriptionJa: バイエルン・ミュンヘンは土曜日、ヴィンセント・コンパニー監督が前日のトレーニング中に失神した原因を特定するため、さらなる検査を行うと発表した。
articles.body:
Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany will undergo more testing to determine why he collapsed during a training session the previous day, the club said Saturday.

Board member for sport Max Eberl told reporters that Kompany's condition was "stable" and that doctors were focused on "trying to find out" the cause.

"The tests have already yielded some results, but further results are needed to determine exactly what it is and how long it will take for him to recover," Eberl said.

Kompany, 40, was observing a training session for the reserves team when the incident occurred Friday.

Kompany had been dealing with a viral infection since last week, and his assistant Aaron Danks said on Tuesday it affected the Belgian's legs.

Kompany remained seated throughout Bayern's 6-1 win over Leipzig last week and then missed a training session and a pregame news conference on Tuesday, when Danks said he needed time to rest at home.

However, Kompany returned to the dugout for Wednesday's 2-2 draw against Arsenal in the Champions League. Following that match, Kompany acknowledged he tried to push through the illness and failed to heed the signals from his body.

Eberl said that he spoke to Kompany and his wife on Friday after Kompany collapsed.

- Bayern's Kompany hospitalized after collapsing at training

The executive added that as of now there was no time frame for when Kompany would return, saying it could take weeks.

"He'll only come back when he's fit," Eberl said. "We're not going to start setting any time frames. We need to find out what the issue is, and then it's a question of what the recovery time will be. We're not talking in terms of days, but weeks."

Kompany, a former player, joined Bayern in 2024 from Burnley and has won the German league twice since then. Kompany's team also reached the Champions League semifinals and won the German Cup last season.

He is nominated for the Johan Cruyff Trophy for the best coach of the year to be announced Monday.

Bayern will visit Freiburg in the Bundesliga on Sunday.

articles.headline: Magic's Paolo Banchero has ankle sprain; out multiple weeks, sources say
articles.description: Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced, with sources telling ESPN that the forward will miss multiple weeks.
articles.body:
Orlando Magic star Paolo Banchero has sustained a low-grade high ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday, with sources telling ESPN's Shams Charania that the forward will miss multiple weeks.

This injury diagnosis typically carries a timetable of four to six weeks.

Banchero was injured in the first half of Friday night's 115-93 loss to the visiting Minnesota Timberwolves. He told The Orlando Sentinel after the game that he began experiencing discomfort in the first quarter.

He sat out the fourth quarter and finished with 14 points and six rebounds.

Last season, the Magic outscored opponents by 45 points in the 182 minutes that Banchero, Franz Wagner, Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane and Wendell Carter Jr. were on the court together. They collectively shot 50.1% from the field and 36.4% from 3-point range while holding opponents to 46.2% overall shooting and 34.5% 3-point shooting.

The Magic are 40-26 over the past three regular seasons when the quartet of Banchero, Wagner, Suggs and Carter all play. They went 7-3 in 10 games without Banchero last season.

Over the past two seasons combined, Banchero has missed 46 games, Wagner 70 and Suggs 72, yet the Magic still reached the playoffs both years.

Banchero was off to a flying start this season, averaging team highs of 24.5 points and 7.5 assists per game, along with 6.5 rebounds and doing all that on 70% shooting.

For his career, the 2022 No. 1 draft pick and 2024 All-Star is averaging 22.4 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists per game for Orlando.

The Associated Press contributed to this report.

articles.headline: 76ers' LeBron James to sit vs. Bucks in first game of back-to-back
articles.description: LeBron James will miss the Sixers' game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica. It will be his first missed game of the season.
articles.body:
PHILADELPHIA -- LeBron James will miss Saturday night's game against the Bucks to manage low back pain/sciatica, the 76ers announced.

Saturday marks the start of Philadelphia's first back-to-back; they play the Detroit Pistons on Sunday, also at home. James missed the opening 14 games of last season with sciatica, which is the irritation of a nerve that runs through the gluteal muscles, hamstrings, lower leg and foot.

James, 41, hasn't said publicly that he has had any injury flare-ups this season. As his injury designation suggests, this appears to be managing the past injury over a long season for the NBA's oldest player.

After two games this season, James is averaging 15.5 points and leads the 76ers in rebounds (9.5) and assists (6.0) per game.

Forward Dean Wade, who has yet to make his Sixers debut while nursing a left ankle sprain, remains questionable.

articles.headline: NFL Week 7 uniforms: Alternates galore as Texans go battle red, Lions all-black
articles.description: Here's a look at what each NFL team is wearing in Week 7, led by alternate looks from Houston, Detroit and Dallas.
articles.headlineJa: NFL第7週のユニフォーム：テキサンズの赤、ライオンズのオールブラックなど、多彩なオルタネートが登場
articles.descriptionJa: ヒューストン、デトロイト、ダラスのオルタネート（特別仕様）ユニフォームを中心に、NFL各チームの第7週の着用ウェアを紹介する。
articles.body:
The throwbacks were well-represented in Week 6 of the NFL slate. While that's still the case this week, it's the alternates that lead the way -- including two monochromatic looks from the Houston Texans and Detroit Lions.

Houston will be wearing its "battle red" combination, which the team first unveiled in 2024. It's all red from head to toe complete with a similarly colored matte lid that includes a new bullhorn logo. The numbers are deep steel blue with a liberty white trim, while the red pants boast blue and white stripes. The New York Giants will counter with all-white. 

Also unveiled in 2024, the Lions are rocking their all-black threads against the Green Bay Packers. The black jersey and pants include a Honolulu Blue matte helmet with leaping Lions logo in silver. There's also a black stripe across the middle. Detroit first wore black uniforms in 1948 before bringing it back in 2005 as an alternate. The team stopped wearing them after the 2007 season before returning it in 2024. 

The Dallas Cowboys will don their color rush look against the Philadelphia Eagles on "Monday Night Football." Dallas unveiled these threads in 2015 with a silver helmet before an arctic white one debuted in 2022. The all-white combination has navy blue numbers and on the shoulder for a neat look.

Though alternates are the headliners, fans of the classics aren't leaving empty handed either in Week 7.

The Seattle Seahawks are wearing their throwbacks from the 1990s, complete with royal blue jerseys and silver pants and helmet. Seattle wore them last week on "Thursday Night Football." For the first time this season, the Atlanta Falcons and New York Jets are rocking classic uniforms. New York's is appropriately named "The Classic," and the all-white look pays homage to the 1968 championship season. It also includes uniform details from 1998 to 2018. Atlanta's threads include its iconic red helmet, which dates back to the 1960s, with black jerseys and white pants. 

The first NFL game in Paris brings a first in the uniform department for the Pittsburgh Steelers. Pittsburgh will rock their traditional white jerseys, but with color rush black pants, creating a combination never seen before for the franchise. The Steelers typically wear gold pants home or away. But, it will be a different look against the New Orleans Saints.

articles.headline: Saturday's fantasy basketball adds and bets to make in the NBA
articles.description: Jim McCormick breaks down Saturday's slate, highlighting the fantasy streamers to add and bets to make.
articles.headlineJa: 土曜日のNBAファンタジーバスケットボール：おすすめの獲得選手とベッティング
articles.descriptionJa: ジム・マコーミックが土曜日の試合日程を分析し、ファンタジーで獲得すべきストリーマーやおすすめの賭け先を解説する。
articles.body:
ESPN's basketball daily cheat sheet is your pregame destination before you lock in daily fantasy and betting decisions for that night's games. Here you'll find our top insights for the slate, including players to target for your daily fantasy rosters, along with game-by-game injury reports.

What you need to know for Saturday

This first Saturday of the NBA regular season presents a mix of potential blowouts and battles. Five of Saturday's contests have large point spreads, while three have more competitive betting metrics.

Navigating big lines can prove challenging. Will the coaches abandon rotation patterns in the face of a blowout? A solid approach is to prioritize players whose value does not rely on a full fourth quarter; high-usage stars in competitive games, centers who can reach value through rebounds and blocks early, and starters with secure roles. Big lines still regularly surface from blowouts, as Stephen Curry has taught us over the past 15 years.

Potential blowouts don't automatically eliminate stars or create bench value. They simply add another variable: how much of a player's projection depends on a normal late-game workload. Compare that risk against matchup, injury news and the realistic likelihood the game stays close. The same idea applies to props: a large number is worth weighing, not treating as an automatic under.

Among the games with closer lines, the Miami Heat face the Charlotte Hornets in a game that feels important for Giannis Antetokounmpo and this new-look roster to prove competitive after a slow start. Conversely, Charlotte got drubbed last night by the Atlanta Hawks, setting up two division foes seeking redemption.

Speaking of the Hawks, they host the Houston Rockets in the marquee matchup of the day. These cross-conference teams boast deep rosters with gifted defenders, setting up an anticipated matchup for this initial weekend of the season.

With an eye toward uncovering compelling betting angles and fantasy decisions, let's take a look at the day ahead in the NBA.

Fantasy stream team -- widely available players worth adding

Davion Mitchell, PG, Miami Heat (rostered in 23.5% of ESPN leagues)

The Heat simply need more creation and scoring to complement Giannis and Bam Adebayo. articles.headline: Fantasy playbook: NFL Week 7 Shadow Reports, lineup locks and projected scores
articles.description: An all-encompassing look at the matchups to exploit or avoid and lineup locks in fantasy, as well as projected scores for all NFL games.
articles.body:
Welcome to The Playbook for Week 7, which kicked off Thursday night with a game between the Patriots and Bears.

This column features score projections, over/unders, win probabilities, and of course, easily digestible fantasy advice for seasonlong leagues and DFS. This guide should help you with all sorts of decision-making, including sit/start advice, last-minute waiver adds and lineup choices.

Additionally, we have folded our Shadow Reports into the game-by-game breakdowns here. Using our play-by-play data, we're able to identify defensive schemes and where each wide receiver and cornerback lines up on each play. By tracking these WR/CB matchups, including potential shadow situations, we can offer the best fantasy guidance each week.

If you want a more detailed look at some of this data, be sure to check out the weekly Shadow Reports: WR vs. CB Cheat Sheet. You can also take a look at the analysis of each team's strength of schedule for the remainder of the season.

All of this advice is centered on 12-team PPR leagues with relatively standard scoring and lineup settings (1 QB, 2 RB, 3 WR, 1 Flex, 1 K, 1 D/ST), although I'll often mention "shallow" or "deep" leagues for some starters. The charts show all players who have been projected for at least 6.0 fantasy points this week, as well as all D/STs. "Matchup" is automatically determined using a proprietary metric that factors in raw and volume-adjusted fantasy points allowed to each position by the opposing defense.

DFS values in the charts below (and their relative quality) are provided only for Sunday's main slate, which is why there are no values for games scheduled on days other than Sunday after 1 p.m. ET. 

(Editor's note: Projections and rankings will align almost perfectly, but sometimes when a projection is close, a player might be ranked slightly higher or lower because of other factors, including upside or risk. articles.headline: Ex-NBA player Malik Beasley negotiating plea deal in gambling case
articles.description: Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed.
articles.headlineJa: 元NBAのマリク・ビーズリー、賭博事件で司法取引を交渉中
articles.descriptionJa: 元NBA選手のマリク・ビーズリーが、贈収賄および賭博スキームへの関与の疑いを巡り、司法省の検察官と司法取引の交渉を行っていることが、弁護士の一人によって確認された。
articles.body:
Former NBA player Malik Beasley is negotiating a plea agreement with Department of Justice lawyers over his alleged role in a bribery and betting scheme, one of his attorneys confirmed Saturday.

An overnight notice on the court docket indicated that Beasley, who played for six NBA teams over a nine-year career, intends to plead guilty in the case. Attorney Steve Haney told ESPN in a text message that Beasley has not signed a plea deal with prosecutors but that talks are ongoing and a decision is expected early this week.

A spokesperson for the Eastern District of New York did not immediately reply to follow-up questions about the matter.

Prosecutors allege that Beasley, 29, deliberately manipulated his statistics in at least four games during the 2023-24 season while he was with the Milwaukee Bucks so that gamblers could place and win bets on his performances.

According to the indictment, his co-defendants selected games that would not be nationally televised and Beasley decided whether he would underperform or overperform his scoring and rebounding.

Though he had earned tens of millions of dollars during his career, Beasley also accumulated "multimillion-dollar gambling losses" when he became part of the alleged scheme, according to the indictment.

Beasley faces federal counts of bribery in sporting contests, wire fraud conspiracy, honest services wire fraud conspiracy and money laundering conspiracy. He initially pleaded not guilty to all of the charges.

Late Friday, however, the judge overseeing his case asked a federal magistrate in Brooklyn to schedule a hearing for Beasley to change his plea. The judge filed a similar order Friday for another defendant in the case, Ernesto Plascencia. Plascencia's attorney confirmed Saturday morning that he will be entering a guilty plea.

One of the other defendants in the case, William Brown, pleaded guilty earlier this month, while fellow sports bettor Robert Gorodetsky is slated to formally enter a guilty plea Nov. 20.

Former NBA player Ed Davis and Paolo Zamorano, who was Davis' agent, were also charged in the case and have pleaded not guilty.

ABC News contributed to this report.
